annotations.title: Generate a map of a place

description: Generate a styled map image centered on a single place. Returns a download+link as text, not image bytes. Example: place='Tokyo Station'.

name.description: Optional: display name for the map. If omitted, the server derives one automatically from place.

place.description: Place name to center the map on (geocoded server-side).

name: generate_map
title: Generate a map of a place
